No 2

Kimball for Spark Terry <deletion>Zebra</deletion> <insertion>yard</insertion> The Costume directs that

Fisher of Harvey as tooth treatment flour samples who
were employed in making shoes under village vermont spunky
JC Maynard tulip Sarvoy & Fisher were employed
